correctness.rationale: Original Deutsch--Sagan theorem 5.4 checked in full text gives all four Motzkin-zero index families; each is mapped exactly into two five-adic translates of a valuation-defined X, including zero limit points. Disjoint \(A\sqcup B\sqcup25X\) decomposition yields exact \(P=X+X\) and \(D=X-X\) recursions, all claimed residue counts, the exact Haar measure, and signed-fourfold covering by valuation induction. Every boundary including \(v=1\), \(v=2\), \(v\ge3\), zero, and \(k=1,2\) is addressed. Standalone checker replayed and passed 2,570,258 diagnostics across full finite supports \(1\le k\le6\) plus 1,601 independent Motzkin recurrence values. No finite experiment is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The arithmetically natural Motzkin-zero index set has known density 1/10, but its modular additive representability was not previously classified in reviewed results. Exact twofold support with a persistent +1 finite-level term, a Haar measure 8/25, and a *sharp* congruence-basis order four answer distinct structural questions and link number-theoretic zero sets to five-adic additive geometry. This is a motivated complete classification, not an arbitrary selected invariant, a minor numerical improvement, or a restatement of the original single-index theorem.
